top3.headline: Nvidia's board reportedly moves to oust Jensen Huang
top3.whyItMatters: A CEO exit at the top AI chip supplier would test every compute plan; watch the board.

top3.headline: Google ships an API built to choose, not write
top3.whyItMatters: Much enterprise AI work is picking from options; a purpose-built model can now score it in one pass.

top3.headline: Older GPUs are holding rental value far longer than expected
top3.whyItMatters: Do not plan on cheap compute soon; H100 rents sit 54% above the depreciation path.

items.title: Nvidia's board reportedly prepares to fire CEO Jensen Huang
items.takeaway: The WSJ reports the board may meet today after a second alleged affair; shares fell over 7% after hours.
items.soWhat: Key-person risk at the top AI chip supplier is now live; review your compute exposure.

items.title: AI agent web traffic grew 8x from August to October
items.takeaway: a16z cites HUMAN Security; The Verge reports United won't let AI agents book flights.
items.soWhat: Decide now whether agents are customers you serve or traffic you block.

related.name: a16z: Welcome to the B2A Economy

items.title: Theo: Gemini 4 Carbon took 22 minutes, Opus 5.5 under 10
items.takeaway: He says most of the delay is server side, with 11 seconds before the first response.
items.soWhat: Benchmark scores hide latency; time models on your own tasks before switching.

items.title: a16z: H100 rental rates run 54% above expected depreciation
items.takeaway: As of Oct 19, A100s sat 9% and H100s 54% above a six-year straight-line path.
items.soWhat: Compute keeps its value longer than planned, so budget for rental prices staying high.

items.title: Perplexity: general models beat cyber models at breaking its agent sandbox
items.takeaway: Red-teaming SPACE, GPT 5.6 Sol found exploits better than GPT 5.6 Sol Cyber.
items.soWhat: Test agent sandboxes with your strongest general model, not only specialist security tools.

items.title: Google launches an API that scores 1,000 choices in one pass
items.takeaway: Gemini Decision 1 picks from closed sets across text, images, audio, video and PDFs.
items.soWhat: Triage, tagging and routing are closed-set choices; test whether this beats your current setup.

items.title: DeepMind's AlphaGenome 2 predicts how mutations act in specific cells
items.takeaway: Trained on 100M+ cell profiles; free for academic research via API, private preview for commercial use.
items.soWhat: AI for science is becoming a research tool; health and pharma teams should test access now.

items.title: Anthropic says Mythos ported Claude to AMD chips in three days
items.takeaway: Simon Willison transcribed the IPO roadshow video: Claude now trains and serves on four chip families.
items.soWhat: If agents port software to new chips in days, single-supplier lock-in weakens.

image.alt: Simon Willison: Anthropic says Mythos ported Claude to AMD chips in three days

items.title: A Perplexity agent on Fable 5.2 built a browser game in hours
items.takeaway: Aravind Srinivas says a Teammate built an endless zombie shooter, all in code, no 3D assets.
items.soWhat: Hours-long unattended agent runs now yield working software, not just drafts.

items.title: Matt Pocock: domain-driven design, not agents, wows his students most
items.takeaway: Build a shared domain language, use it with the agent, refactor the code to match.
items.soWhat: Agents work better when your team names the business clearly; that is a leadership job.

items.title: Meng To turns his three.js game into a trailer with Fable 5.2
items.takeaway: He shared a 60-second trailer the model made from his game.
items.soWhat: Marketing assets can now come from the product itself, cutting design cycles.

items.title: Harrison Chase crosses out context engineering for goal engineering
items.takeaway: He struck through context engineering and harness engineering and posted 'goal engineering'.
items.soWhat: Builders are moving from feeding agents context to defining the outcomes agents must reach.

items.title: AI 2027 authors now expect top-researcher-level AI in 2027
items.takeaway: Per Rowan Cheung, they moved timelines up after METR estimated Anthropic improves about 2x as fast thanks to AI.
items.soWhat: Forecasters closest to the labs are shortening timelines, so stress-test your three-year plans.

items.title: Cursor rebuilds Projects so teams and their agents share one workspace
items.takeaway: Cursor says teammates' agents can now coordinate with each other inside a shared project.
items.soWhat: Agent work is becoming a team activity, so plan for shared context and permissions.

items.title: VulnCheck: Glasswing logged 37,966 findings, only 217 marked fixed
items.takeaway: It counts 442 CVEs tied to Anthropic, two exploited; curl rejected 19 of 34 scanner reports.
items.soWhat: AI finds bugs faster than people can verify and fix them, so budget for triage.

items.title: Claude now runs full apps like Adobe and Box beside the chat
items.takeaway: Expanded MCP Apps support lets app tools and embedded sites run inside Claude on web and desktop.
items.soWhat: Claude is becoming the place work happens, not just a chat window beside your tools.

items.title: OpenAI lets businesses build agents that answer customers in ChatGPT
items.takeaway: In beta: claim a business profile, manage its information, see engagement and build a Business Agent.
items.soWhat: ChatGPT is becoming a storefront, so claim your profile before others describe you.

items.title: Meng To looped a cheap model through 800 page designs
items.takeaway: Over 24 hours, each version was screenshotted, critiqued and rebuilt; he reports a $0 model bill.
items.soWhat: Cheap models in critique loops can explore design options at near-zero cost.

items.title: Lyn Alden: wary of Huang's tenure, bullish on 2027 GPU demand
items.takeaway: She calls herself neutral to bearish on Huang as CEO and bullish on GPU demand in 2027.
items.soWhat: A respected macro voice separates Nvidia's leadership risk from the demand for AI compute.

items.title: Nathan Benaich: defenders need open cyber models too
items.takeaway: He says Hugging Face found API guardrails slowed an intrusion probe and used a self-hosted open model.
items.soWhat: Closed-model guardrails can block your own security team; keep an open-model option for incidents.

voices.quote: DDD has never been more powerful.
Had a Teammate run on Fable 5.2 for a few hours and build an endless zombie shooter that you can play on your browser.
This is what the early stage of a platform shift looks like: adoption is measurable, but the business models it enables mostly aren't visible yet.
It predicts the impact of DNA variants in different specific cell types - unlocking crucial information for understanding complex diseases.

hotOnX.text: Gemini Decisions API: a new Gemini Decision 1 model scores up to 1,000 closed-set questions in a single pass.
hotOnX.note: A new model type, built to choose rather than write, caught builders' attention.

hotOnX.text: Anthropic's current lead over other labs is the biggest any lab has had since GPT-3.
hotOnX.note: Builders are debating whether one lab now sets the pace for everyone.

hotOnX.text: My AI Engineer talk goes live in 10 minutes.
hotOnX.note: Her keynote drew a standing-room crowd, per swyx.

hotOnX.text: Gemini 4 Carbon low: 22m21s. Opus 5.5 high: 9m33s. Unacceptably slow in real use.
hotOnX.note: Speed in real work, not benchmark scores, decides which model builders keep.

hotOnX.text: If you can describe business processes in clear, consistent language, you've half-built the software to automate them.
hotOnX.note: Clear business language is turning into a direct input for agent-built software.
